title: Chronicle Gold Event
description: One hand-labeled event used to evaluate the pipeline. Stored as a JSONL line per event. The gold set should be ~300-500 events stratified across articles and eras (esp. the BC/AD boundary and multi-date 'Ussher-type' sentences).

revision_id.description: Frozen revision the bullet was taken from — makes the gold set reproducible.

true_year.description: Signed year the event ACTUALLY occurred (negative = BC). For Ussher's bullet this is 1650, not -4004.

referenced_years.description: Other dates mentioned in the bullet that are NOT the event anchor (e.g. [-4004] for Ussher). Used to score temporal grounding.

true_wikilink.description: Canonical Wikipedia article title for the event's primary subject; empty string if none applies.

is_event.description: False if the bullet is not actually an event (e.g. a stray See-also/reference line). Used to score junk-filtering.

is_multi_date.description: True if the bullet contains more than one date (the grounding-hard slice).

source.bullet_text: 1650 Bishop James Ussher calculates date of creation as October 23, 4004 BC

examples.notes: Canonical grounding case: event occurred in 1650; 4004 BC is the content of the calculation.
